notes: I discovered the m-drop rule is broader than "words starting with exam": a lowercase `m` is dropped when it ends a word (e.g. `room`→`roo`) or when it's immediately preceded by `exa` (case-insensitive), while uppercase `M` is never dropped. This unifies E4's `"Exam room"→"Exa roo"` and E6's `"an EXAM room"→"An exam roo"` with all the `example`/`exam` cases.
